items: #330: count a link only if it opens
Adds _reply_links_page to hook.py and moves its four callers onto it: _long_reply_words, _check_page, the owed-page counter and _record_qa_link. Also adds five verify.py cases.

make_page.py prints one line when a page is written outside the folder it runs in, and this step adds one verify.py case. It does not depend on step 1 and touches different files, but it runs after step 1 so that only one helper works at a time.
Moves the systems-doc section "A page link must open" from planned to built, with real line numbers. Then it bumps the house-rules version, runs verify.py twice and builds the QA page.
The pull request into main says Refs #329 and never Closes #329. You test from the QA page.

changes: verify.py baseline on the fix branch
Measured today: 4 of 847 checks fail on main before any change is made.
"RESULT: FAIL - 4 of 847 checks failed": checks 95 and 97 (guard branch rules), 751 (clear writing on a page) and 826 (pagecheck on a hand-written page).
After the change, the same 4 checks fail and no new ones do. Each new case passes.
The 4 failures are on main already and look tied to running in a separate working folder. They are out of scope here. If they still fail when run from the main folder, they get their own issue.
